why: removes 1 mixin injection handler(s): check each still applies somewhere, with the same effect
reviewed: 26.1.2's setupFog returns the one FogData that is both the clear colour and what updateBuffer uploads, so the authors' setupColor TAIL (colour, any medium) and setupFog TAIL (distances, in air) are one setupFog RETURN edit of that FogData with the same two conditions. ECA-026 (carried from 1.21.11): the distances are set per the extension's shape -- the custom start/end go to the environmental (SPHERE) or render-distance (CYLINDER, 1.21.1's forced default) pair, the other pair lerped by strength to a distance where fog.glsl's max never picks it -- and the sky end from the extension, all only with no fluid in the camera; the colour is still blended in any medium.

reviewed: 26.1 removed GameRenderer.getDepthFar, so the force-loaded far-plane extension moved to CameraDepthFarMixin, which raises Camera.depthFar right after Camera.update stores it (before the culling projection and perspective use it) and is added by mixin_add.

why: removes 2 mixin injection handler(s): check each still applies somewhere, with the same effect
reviewed: Re-derived from the 26.1.2 sources and javap, not inherited. The authors removed three handlers; each has a 26.1.2 home with 1.21.1's effect. renderClouds HEAD: clouds are a frame-graph pass whose lambda (lambda$addCloudsPass$0) first tries LevelRenderState.customCloudsRenderer (null-checked) and only then CloudRenderer.render, so the skip is a HEAD cancel of that lambda (require = 1) -- it also covers dimensions drawing their own clouds, which the CloudRendererMixin gate (kept as a second gate) alone missed. renderEntity: the @Redirect of EntityRenderDispatcher.submit in submitEntities sets the cloud-occlusion flag in the main pass, before the clouds pass runs. Its fog half (1.21.1 pushed fog start/end to MAX_VALUE around renderEntity; ECA-026, carried from 1.21.11): the world fog slice is written once in setupFog and bound when the features are drawn, so a force-loaded entity with no fluid in the camera is submitted into the mixin's own FeatureRenderDispatcher (26.1.2's 8-argument constructor: ModelManager and GameRenderState, as GameRenderer's) and drawn at once inside the main pass (lambda$addMainPass$0 calls setShaderFog before submitEntities) with FogRenderer.getBuffer(FogMode.NONE), the previous slice restored after (GameRenderer.fogRenderer opened by the access transformer). renderSky TAIL: AfterSky only fires inside the sky pass, which renderLevel omits when shouldRenderSky (!bossOverlay.shouldCreateWorldFog()) is false and addSkyPass omits for Skybox NONE, lava/powder snow and sky-blocking effects, and it fires even after a custom CustomSkyboxRenderer.renderSky returned true; so the skybox is drawn from its own pass on targets.main injected before addMainPass (require = 1), with RenderSystem.setShaderFog(terrainFog) as the sky pass does, skipped when the @ModifyExpressionValue on renderSky in lambda$addSkyPass$0 (require = 1) saw it return true and, on a frame with no sky pass (shouldRenderSky false for boss world fog, Skybox NONE, lava/powder snow, sky-blocking effects, where 26.1.2 never calls renderSky but 1.21.1 still asked it before the TAIL), when levelRenderState.customSkyboxRenderer is non-null (extractLevel fills it before renderLevel, per javap of minecraft-patched-26.1.2.116-merged.jar), and GlobalSkyboxHook.passOwned makes the AfterSky handler stand down. renderLevel multiplies modelViewMatrix onto RenderSystem's model-view stack and LegacyGl/RenderType.draw upload getModelViewMatrix() as ModelViewMat, so the skybox PoseStack starts from identity (the old new Matrix4f(event.getModelViewMatrix()) applied the view rotation twice).
